defects.statement: applyCommonGroundRail interact branch calls ctx.noteScreeningAction before ctx.performStoryInteraction. The real performStoryInteraction immediately checks screeningActionReady and refuses the now-consumed cadence. All ch13 movie interact acts therefore starve while their ready prompts remain visible.
defects.requestedRepair: Let the shared performStoryInteraction own its existing cadence; remove premature consumption in chapter rail. Preserve real interaction resolver/input proof and no timeout rescue. Add a regression through applyCommonGroundRail with a cadence-aware shared performer rather than an always-success spy. Verify the actual home movie progression then the other ch13 interaction phases.
defects.verificationRoute: Producer observed source cause and 70-second hardware movie stagnation. Fresh independent verifier still running; not yet its final finding. Then independent real movie/lifecycle proof after the bounded fix.

defects.statement: nextWaypoint scans the entire polyline on every tick and selects the FIRST point farther than 1.2 units from the current body. Once the body leaves the initial point by more than 1.2 units, that already visited start becomes the next target again. Both the long survey rail and common rail pass their complete unsliced route to this stateless scan.
defects.requestedRepair: Track ordered controller traversal/reconstruct it from actual recorded progress and current body, without granting route proof. Never retarget already passed points during ordinary forward walking. Reset or reconstruct correctly for Continue/revision/beat changes; real world/route predicates remain the sole progress authority. Add a multi-tick rail regression that physically follows emitted move targets through all turns on both signed polylines and reaches the far end without shortcuts or toggling back to start. Then prove actual browser movie flow.
defects.verificationRoute: Source-observed; browser survey/common not yet reached because CG-IMPL-004 blocks home. Then independent real movie/lifecycle proof after the bounded fix.

defects.statement: The new chapter compares live capsule-centre positions with ground-authored poses; the survey movie physically reaches S but its subunit 3D arrival gate remains unsatisfiable.
defects.requestedRepair: Reconcile chapter physical coordinate semantics for arrival, recording, support, sockets, occupancy, clearance and traversal using actual capsule/up/ground facts. Preserve geometry and all physical predicates; test real centre-to-ground offsets and shared gait behavior.
defects.verificationRoute: Meaningful physical/AV integration regression followed by independent actual browser cold/continuous/manual/Continue evidence and affected independent reviewers. No test-only closure.
